type Keys<U extends Array<keyof (U & string)>> = U;
type KeyInfer<T> = T extends infer U extends Array<keyof (U & string)> ? U : never;
type Length<U extends Array<(U & string)['length']>> = U;
type LengthInfer<T> = T extends infer U extends Array<(U & string)['length']> ? U : never;
type NumberMethod<U extends Array<(U & number)['toString']>> = U;
type NumberInfer<T> = T extends infer U extends Array<(U & number)['toString']> ? U : never;

type Mapped<U extends Array<{
  [K in keyof (U & string)]: unknown;
}>> = U;
type MappedInfer<T> = T extends infer U extends Array<{
  [K in keyof (U & string)]: unknown;
}> ? U : never;
type DirectMapped<U extends {
  [K in keyof (U & string)]: unknown;
}> = U;
